mapper.insert: INSERT INTO category ( name, category_type, parent_id, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{name}, #{categoryType}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, category_type, parent_id, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM category WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, category_type, parent_id, sort_order, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM category
WHERE parent_id IS NULL
WHERE parent_id = #{parentId}
ORDER BY sort_order ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC

WITH RECURSIVE category_path AS ( SELECT id, name, parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM category WHERE id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.name, c.parent_id, cp.depth + 1 FROM category c INNER JOIN category_path cp ON c.id = cp.parent_id ) SELECT name FROM category_path ORDER BY depth DESC

SELECT scs.id, CONCAT(lcs.name, ' > ', mcs.name, ' > ', scs.name) AS category_path FROM category scs JOIN category mcs ON scs.parent_id = mcs.id JOIN category lcs ON mcs.parent_id = lcs.id WHERE scs.id IN
#{id}
